create_rpc_client: create a Client instance to connect to an RPC server at a given host and port
call_remote_method: call any server method transparently through the Client object using attribute access
wrap_socket_for_pickle: wrap a raw socket with FileSock to make it usable by pickle serialization
send_file_over_socket: send a file handle contents over a socket connection using inline_send_handle
send_string_over_socket: send a string over a socket connection using inline_send_string with size prefix
